input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts, which is outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and approaches the walk-away position of foreign law with exclusive foreign venue. It also conflicts directly with Section 28.2, which already grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County. The surgical fix substitutes only the jurisdiction and forum words in 28.1 with New York law and the New York County courts, keeping the rest of the sentence, 28.2's venue provisions, and 28.3's escalation process intact.

ops.oldText: Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have
ops.newText: the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have swapped the Singapore jurisdiction and forum words for New York law and the New York County courts, which is our standard governing-law position and removes the conflict with the exclusive New York jurisdiction already agreed in Section 28.2. If New York is not workable, we can accept Delaware or California law and courts, or English law with the courts of London.
proposal.summary: Substitute New York law and New York County courts for Singapore in 28.1, leaving the rest of the sentence intact.
